candidates: Timeout/MemorySize properties of CompressionFunction in the IaC template
answer.explanation: Nearly every CompressionFunction invocation in the window ends with Status: timeout at exactly 3000.00 ms. The other functions complete in roughly 25-240 ms, so the fault is specific to this function. Max Memory Used stays around 93-98 MB, so this is not memory exhaustion. The likely cause is that the 3 s timeout and 128 MB memory setting are too small for the compression workload, since Lambda allocates CPU in proportion to memory. Init Duration of about 380-490 ms on cold starts adds to the pressure. The log excerpt was truncated and no tools were available, so I could not confirm the change history or IAM denials; the CONFIG attribution rests on the log evidence alone.
